bullets.text: Damage was reported in the farm belt during the Estenwick tornado outbreak.
There were 3 fatalities in Millrow district during the Estenwick tornado outbreak. People were evacuated from Estenwick and Dray Corners during evacuation and displacement operations.
Estenwick Police deployed to Estenwick and Millrow district as response operations continued. A warning was issued for Estenwick, Dray Corners, and Ostley County during emergency communications.
Route 12 and grain elevator were destroyed in Dray Corners during the Estenwick tornado outbreak.
